# No Code MBA

> > A comprehensive learning platform offering courses, tutorials, and expert interviews for building apps, automating workflows, and launching SaaS products without writing code.

No Code MBA provides structured learning tracks and step-by-step tutorials across leading no-code platforms like Bubble, Lovable, Cursor, Airtable, Figma, Webflow, and more. The platform combines video courses, case studies, and a podcast to help beginners and entrepreneurs build real projects using no-code tools.

## Key Topics

- No Code MBA
- Bubble
- Lovable
- Cursor
- Airtable
- Figma
- Webflow

- App Building
- Automation
- Web Design

## Getting Started

- [No Code MBA Homepage](https://www.nocode.mba): Main hub with featured courses on Bubble, Lovable, Cursor and more
- [Sign Up for No Code MBA](https://www.nocode.mba/sign-up): Access No Code MBA Unlimited with 100+ lessons and exclusive content
- [No Code 101: Learn The Fundamentals](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/intro-to-no-code): Beginner-friendly fundamentals course for learning no-code basics and building first projects

## Learning Tracks & Courses

- [Browse All Courses](https://www.nocode.mba/courses): Complete course catalog with step-by-step tutorials building real projects
- [The AI SaaS Course](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/The-AI-SaaS-Course): Build SaaS products with Lovable and Cursor from idea to customers
- [Build AI Apps with No-Code](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/building-apps-with-ai): Beginner's guide to building real working AI apps with no-code tools
- [The Complete Guide to Bubble](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/the-complete-guide-to-bubble): Comprehensive Bubble course for building functional web apps with databases
- [The Complete Guide to Airtable](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/the-airtable-masterclass): Airtable masterclass transforming spreadsheets into powerful databases
- [The Complete Guide to Google Sheets](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/the-google-sheets-masterclass): Google Sheets masterclass covering formulas, automation and dashboards
- [The Complete Guide to Zapier](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/zapier): Zapier guide for automating workflows by connecting 5,000+ apps

## Design & Development Tools

- [The Ultimate Guide to Figma](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/The-Ultimate-Guide-to-Figma): Figma guide for designing interfaces and prototypes without code
- [The Complete Guide to Webflow](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/webflow-complete-course): Webflow guide for designing responsive websites with CMS capabilities
- [The Complete Guide to Glide Apps](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/learn-to-build-apps-with-glide): Glide guide for building mobile apps and MVPs in minutes
- [The Complete FlutterFlow Developer Course](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/The-Beginner-Guide-to-FlutterFlow-): FlutterFlow course for creating professional mobile apps
- [Webflow Cloneable Directory](https://www.nocode.mba/webflow-cloneables): Hand-picked free Webflow components and cloneable templates
